changes.comment: Coverage is now measured and gated. No package in the devtools suite had a threshold of any kind, so nothing stopped coverage falling; the tooling to measure it was not installed either. Thresholds are set at what is actually met so a regression fails the build, with type declarations and entry points excluded because counting files that compile to nothing measures how much of a package is types rather than how much of its logic is tested. Modules that are genuinely under-tested are left in the numbers rather than excluded — hiding one makes the figure look better and the package no safer.
